scope: Same-host backend swap on an already-working sole testnet voter with a prepared dedicated standalone X710 port
applicability: One observed configuration; other kernels, firmware, clients, clusters and hardware require separate validation. Not a general supported-platform matrix.
preconditions: One active voting instance on this host; other replicas/start automation fenced or paused
Independent protected management and tested stop/recovery path
Working explicit socket configuration on same standalone port
Current consensus history and existing restart validation preserved
NIC queue/RSS/offloads already prepared, saved state and site rollback available
Hugepages/mounts/memlock/cgroup memory already provisioned for both backends
Trusted snapshot policy, sandbox, privilege drop and localhost RPC/metrics retained

The portable collector reads one selected service cgroup. Before measuring, confirm ALL validator tiles are in that cgroup. Tiles moved into another cgroup will be omitted and the CPU/resource totals will be incomplete. The measured X710 layout satisfied this prerequisite. Multi-cgroup layouts need a separately reviewed collector.

operations.effects: No intended host configuration mutation; output can contain site metadata, so inspect before sharing.
Reads systemd/procfs/sysfs/ethtool and writes a new private output directory; no service or network configuration changes. Not a watchdog.
Reads selected local capture; output redirection writes a local report.
Reads STATE/socket.toml and writes or replaces STATE/xdp.toml; does not install it or change host networking/services. Review diff.

effects: Stops voting service and interrupts voting until recovery
Replaces existing service TOML with reviewed candidate
Starts existing service; runtime attaches XDP
operations.automation: No unattended apply script; runbook has explicit stop/review/verify decision points.

required: Driver-mode XDP attachment on intended physical port
Correct cluster/identity, catch-up and independently advancing own votes
zero_copy_proof.copy_vs_zero_copy: A/B used ordinary socket backend; C used physical forced AF_XDP zero-copy. No equal-settings native-XDP copy arm was measured.

steps: Stop service and verify empty cgroup
Restore both saved loopback sysctl values
Preserve newest history; never roll history back
Confirm experiment XDP attachments gone; investigate ownership if remaining
Run existing history restart check and restart
does_not_restore: NIC preparation performed before this recipe
rollback.failure_rule: Keep service stopped when prerequisite/ownership/history checks fail; use site recovery. Do not blindly detach another XDP program or start a stale replica.

limitations: Sequential ordinary testnet workload, not randomized controlled capacity test
Topology/backend/queue differences and shorter B phase
Unexplained Linux RX drops in standalone phases
No throughput maximum, latency-percentile, energy, losslessness, mainnet, long-term reliability or mlx5-parity result
Reconstructed build and host-changing operator recipe not clean-room replayed
